dreamteamer.title: Meeting docs
dreamteamer.description: The documents a call produces: a `meeting-preps` read before it, a neutral `meeting-summaries` record of what was said, a `meeting-analyses` critique built on the raw transcript, and the `tasks` it leaves. Each points at its `meetings` record, and a prep or critique at its `engagements` record. `/process-new-meetings` runs the chain from calendar sync to critique.
